source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Determine the severity level of the incident.
3. Verify all employees involved and on-site at the time of the accident.
4. Secure the area and ensure nobody gets closer to the scene until the investigation is complete.
5. Collect details: date, time, location, nature of the accident, and sequence of events.
6. Interview witnesses and take their statements.
7. Take photographs and make sketches of the accident scene, highlighting key factors involved.
8. Document injuries, even if they seem minor.
9. Identify the immediate cause and any underlying factors or conditions.
10. Keep records of any safety equipment involved, such as personal protective equipment (PPE), and document its condition and use.
11. Complete an incident report using employer-specific forms, ensuring all details are filled accurately and legibly.
12. If the accident is severe, report to local authorities and follow any mandatory reporting guidelines.
13. Assess whether there are any legal or regulatory notification requirements
